primer: Monster Beverage retains a COMPOUNDER_PASS on quality with 22.07% ROIC, $4.63 billion in cash and investments, and zero debt. Yet Pass 1 found 270 bps of Q3 operating margin compression (28.0%), a 32.1% jump in TCCC commissions ($159.6M 9M), -2.8% 9M cash flow growth, and Americas CEO Rob Gehring's exit. On November 20, 2026, shares fell to $43.69 on 1.7x volume into STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) inside a 10-distribution-day Downtrend. That leaves just +1.62% expected return ($44.40 EV) and 0.81:1 support R:R to $46.00 against a $40.43 stop. Because MNST is NOT_HELD and fails Valuation and Trend, we assign REJECTED (TIER_0, 0% weight) and hold 80% cash with 20% in conditional LLY.
